bug_semantics: When AUTH_ENABLED=true, an external request from outside INTERNAL_SERVICE_IPS that omits X-Internal-Service receives None from request.headers.get(), while an unset INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET also yields None from os.getenv(). is_internal_request() compared those values directly, so None == None returned true; verify_api_key() then created an unauthenticated internal principal with scopes ["all"], satisfying require_scope("admin") and exposing admin key creation, listing, and revocation. The bypass does not by itself pass the generate-master-key handler's additional is_master_key check.
flaw_origin: PR #966 member commit bf2b107e0cbaad0b8f178dc4ebdcca15b3b076f2 created overlays/krolik/api/middleware/auth.py and first wrote the missing-header-versus-unset-secret comparison. GitHub squash commit 658eb3d171df7a038a1b93c799c77dd430ac4671 integrated that member unchanged; 58363aac03acf347bbb74861d0ce1108f345faf4 only simplified the if/return form, and c2bc36b15f818babca5a7c1e787ce86d60341fb0 later performed a 100% rename into src/memos/api/middleware/auth.py, so neither is the introducer.

The squash can be decomposed because the original PR head and member objects are present: member bf2b107e0cbaad0b8f178dc4ebdcca15b3b076f2 creates the complete vulnerable file, its parent lacks both the file and secret mechanism, and its auth.py blob is exactly the blob integrated by the squash.
